Familiar Faces! | manga=Adventures| roundnum=PS462 | roundname=Choices|teamrank=King|teamname=[[Team Plasma]]}} '''N''' (Japanese: '''{{tt|Ｎ|エヌ}}''' ''N'') is a supporting character in the manga series [[Pokémon Adventures]]. He is the former King of Team Plasma, having been raised since childhood by [[Ghetsis]] in order to liberate Pokémon from humans. His full name is '''Natural Harmonia Gropius''' (Japanese: '''ナチュラル・ハルモニア・グロピウス''' ''Natural Harmonia Gropius''). ==Character== N is usually inexpressive. He is also shown to be very caring about Pokémon and was enraged by how the Pokémon are captured with Poké Balls, saying that when they are in the Poké Balls, their "voice" cannot be heard. However, after a few encounters with {{adv|Black}}, N slowly developed interests about Pokémon's friendship with Trainers, and realized that "liberating" Pokémon doesn't make them happy after all, if they're separated against their own will. Though he initially disliked [[Alder]] due to the latter's link to the Pokémon League and Pokémon battling, upon coming to know the former {{pkmn|Champion}} better, N expressed a sympathy with him thanks to his past loss of a Pokémon partner to illness. ==History== ==={{MangaArc|Black & White}}=== [[File:N and Servine Adventures.png|left|thumb|222x222px|N in the Black & White chapter]] N debuted in ''[[PS464|Black's First Trainer Battle]]''. He was first seen watching {{adv|Black}} as he set off on his Pokémon journey. In ''[[PS465|Lights, Camera...Action!]]'', N witnessed Black saving a [[Xtransceiver]] commercial shooting from a wild {{p|Galvantula}}. Once the ordeal was over, N shed a tear from seeing Pokémon being used by humans. In ''[[PS467|Letting Go]]'', N encountered Black at [[Accumula Town]], where he challenged the boy to a battle. During their battle, N expressed his disgust at the [[Pokédex]], claiming that Trainers lock up his "friends" in [[Poké Ball]]s to fill the Pokédex, making them nothing more than a source for information. Black's [[Bo|Tep]] managed to defeat N's {{p|Tympole}}, convincing N that some Pokémon do enjoy the company of their Trainers. After N left to think about what he learned, Black saw a dream from N's past produced from his [[Musha]]'s [[Dream Mist]] and wondered if N wasn't really a bad person. In ''[[PS485|Gigi's Choice]]'', N trapped {{adv|White}} on the {{DL|Nimbasa City|Rondez-View Ferris Wheel}} in order to talk with her. He revealed to White his status as the King of [[Team Plasma]] and asked her [[Gigi]] if it wished to participate in a Pokémon battle. N had his {{adv|Amanda|Servine}} attack Gigi, forcing her to defend herself and knock Servine out with an {{m|Ember}}. Unable to process Gigi's joyous reaction at winning a battle, White chose to jump out of the ferris wheel and beckoned Gigi to come with her. Gigi chose to side with N, shocking White into falling out of the car and onto the ground below. As White lay on the ground unconscious, N revealed he planned to defeat the League Champion before sending Servine down to assist White. In ''[[PS497|Finding Truth]]'', N received the [[Dark Stone]] from [[Ghetsis]]. With it, he successfully awakened {{DL|Tao trio (Adventures)|Zekrom}}, the Legendary Dragon Pokémon of Ideals. After some struggles, he managed to convince Zekrom to join his cause, becoming the Hero of Ideals. In ''[[PS508|The Lesson Ends Here]]'', N met [[Alder]] and challenged him to a [[Double Battle]]. Black, White, and [[Iris]] arrived in time to witness Alder losing the battle. Reacting to Zekrom's presence, the [[Light Stone]] in Black's possession turned into {{DL|Tao trio (Adventures)|Reshiram}}, only to revert back into its stone form immediately afterward. N attempted to leave, but was was attacked by [[Cedric Juniper]], who demanded to know where the [[Gym Leader]]s kidnapped by Team Plasma were being held captive. Black, White, and Cedric teamed up to defeat N's Pokémon, but he still refused to tell them where Team Plasma's base was located. As he flew away on Zekrom, N heard its voice, learning that it wished to battle Black after he fully awakened Reshiram. [[File:Black vs N Adventures.png|thumb|250px|N vs Black]] In ''[[PS520|Cold Hard Truth]]'', Team Plasma launched their attack on the {{un|Pokémon League}}, surrounding the building with [[N's Castle]]. As a form of mockery and display of Team Plasma's power, the Gym Leaders were hoisted on cross-like fixtures and displayed in front of the masses. Having awakened Reshiram, Black battled against N and Zekrom in the skies above the castle. Due to not being used to fighting with Reshiram, Black struggled, but with Cedric's help, he learned how to utilize Reshiram's abilities properly and dealt a heavy blow to Zekrom with Reshiram's {{m|Fusion Flare}}. Zekrom quickly got back up and fled into the castle with Black and Reshiram following after them. They continued their battle, but a second Zekrom appeared to assist the first. Easily seeing through the ruse, Black had Reshiram attack the real Zekrom, defeating it. The second Zekrom revealed itself to be {{TP|N|Zorua}}, who had remained to help N despite him releasing all of his friends prior to the attack on the League. Black told N that Zorua wished to stay with him despite being released. N understood Zorua's wishes, but both ended up passing out. In ''[[PS523|A Difficult Parting]]'', N awakened and thanked Black and White for helping him see the error of his ways. N decided to go find his own path and left on Zekrom's back, leaving Zorua behind. ==={{MangaArc|Black 2 & White 2}}=== [[File:N B2W2 Adventures.png|left|thumb|238x238px|N in the Black 2 & White 2 chapter]] In ''[[PS540|Flying Ship]]'', N and Zekrom returned to Unova, the latter having been attracted by {{DL|Tao trio (Adventures)|Kyurem}}'s growing power. As they traveled, the Light Stone arrived and flew in front of them before stopping at the [[Entralink]], where it was found by White. N reunited with White and took her to Team Plasma's flying ship, the [[Plasma Frigate]]. N revealed that Kyurem was attracting Zekrom and Reshiram towards it so it could fuse with one of them. Shortly after they arrived, Ghetsis exited the Plasma Frigate to battle with his former son. N told White to get to safety, revealing that if Zekrom were to be absorbed, the Light Stone would react and revert into Reshiram once again. In ''[[PS543|Abyssal Ruins]]'', Ghetsis obtained the [[DNA Splicers]], which gave Kyurem the power to revert Zekrom back into the Dark Stone, sealing N inside with it. Reacting to this, the Light Stone pulled White into it, sending her to the [[Pokémon Dream World]], where she met with N. While inside, N and White reunited with Black, who was sealed into the Light Stone two years ago. After Kyurem absorbed Zekrom to become {{DL|List of Pokémon with form differences|Kyurem|Black Kyurem}}, Black told N to stay behind and fight Kyurem from the inside while he and White exited the Light Stone with Reshiram to fight from the outside. After exiting the Light Stone, Black and White launched a counterattack against Kyurem, but were distracted when N was ejected from the Dark Stone, giving Ghetsis the chance to attack and escape. Not wanting N to interfere with his control over Kyurem, Ghetsis knocked him off of Kyurem's back, sending him into the ocean below. Unbeknownst to Ghetsis, [[Colress]] secretly took N aboard the Plasma Frigate, curious about his ability to hear the voices of Pokémon. In ''[[PS547|The Final Battle]]'', {{adv|Whitley}} and [[Hugh]] infiltrated the Plasma Frigate, where they found N and rescued him. Hugh told N about the {{p|Purrloin}} Team Plasma stole from his [[Hugh's sister|sister]] five years ago. N agreed to return Purrloin, but only after Ghetsis was defeated. While Hugh stayed behind with Whitley's [[Foongy]] upon spotting the two Team Plasma Grunts who had stolen Purrloin, Whitley and N made their way to Ghetsis's room, only to encounter Alder and {{adv|Looker}} instead, who been battling Ghetsis before he managed to escape and hide himself. After finding where Ghetsis ran off to, N stated he intended to take all the Pokémon stolen by Team Plasma and return them to where they properly belonged. Suddenly, an explosion tore the Plasma Frigate apart from the inside, sending everyone flying. Ghetsis was saved by N, who stated that despite everything, he still loved Ghetsis as a father. Disgusted, Ghetsis rejected N's love, calling him a monster while beating his former son unconscious and bleeding. As he plummeted towards the ground, Ghetsis laughed at his villainy, only to be surprised when he was rescued by Zekrom. Meanwhile, Foongy returned with Hugh and healed the worst of N's injuries before Black, White, and Iris arrived with Reshiram to rescue everyone. The Plasma Frigate crashed into the abandoned N's Castle, setting the building on fire and putting the liberated Pokémon Team Plasma left behind in danger. By combining the might of all three stages of the Unova [[first partner Pokémon]], Black, White, and the others launched a triple {{m|Fire Pledge|Fire}}, {{m|Grass Pledge|Grass}}, and {{m|Water Pledge}} combination attack, successfully dousing the flames. Afterward, Ghetsis was arrested by the [[International Police]] and taken into custody. N took Hugh and his sister into the castle, where he returned Purrloin to them. N and Black later said their farewells to Zekrom and Reshiram, who flew off together to parts unknown. In ''[[PS548|Epilogue]]'', N was revealed to have been arrested by the International Police. After being released on bail, N worked with Whitley, [[Anthea and Concordia|Anthea, and Concordia]] to return the Pokémon liberated by Team Plasma back to their original owners. ==Pokémon== ===On hand=== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=N |pkmn=Zorua |type1=Dark |gender=male |img=N Zorua Adventures.png |epnum=PS468 |epname=Listening to Pokémon |main=N's Zorua |desc={{p|Zorua}} was first seen in a flashback of N's childhood. When Black arrived at N's Castle, Zorua used his Illusion Ability to take on Zekrom's appearance. Despite N releasing his entire team, Zorua refused to leave N's side, much to N's confusion. When Black revealed that Zorua truly wants to be with his Trainer, N sympathized with him, but left him behind as he bid his farewells.
